objective: Require the manual PowerPoint/WPS playback acceptance gate to bind the final narrated PPTX artifact to a full 64-hex SHA-256 fingerprint before manual acceptance can pass.

behavior.before: The S24 manual playback acceptance gate accepted narrated PPTX artifact fingerprints as short as 16 hex characters after the sha256: prefix.
behavior.after: The gate treats short artifact fingerprints as missing and requires a full sha256: plus 64 lowercase hex characters for the narrated PPTX artifact binding.

checks.failureMode: manual acceptance with a short artifact fingerprint returned accepted

redaction.notes: The report records only status labels, commands, and non-secret artifact-fingerprint policy.
